Subject: SOC 2 - access artifacts: SCIM delta samples & SAML assertion traces

Hi Markus,

We're working through the access-control evidence for Medix Health's SOC 2 readiness review. A couple of quick clarifying asks so we can finalize the sample set: 

- For SCIM, can you provide one week of delta exports (preferably an incremental file showing adds/updates/deletes) and a short note on the sync cadence and conflict resolution policy?
- For SAML, we need a handful of raw assertion samples (redacted PII is fine) covering both: successful auth with role assignment and a failure case (e.g., invalid audience). Timestamps and assertion IDs are helpful.
- A mapping (CSV) of role name -> role owner (owner email) for the scope of Medix Health would speed our sampling.

If you have a Drive folder with the artifacts, share a link; otherwise email attachments are fine. We're targeting completion on 2026-03-05.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramirez
Sr. Security Assessor
Auditor Solutions

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the clear list. We're on it — copying Irene (identity engineering) and Laura (security/compliance) to coordinate artifacts and redaction. Quick notes: 

- We'll provide a week of SCIM deltas (we rotate snapshots nightly; the deltas are generated at 00:15 UTC).
- We'll pull three SAML assertion examples: successful login (role resolved), expired/invalid-audience failure, and a Just-In-Time provisioning trace.
- Role owner mapping: we can export a csv with columns role_name, owner_email, created_at, last_modified_by.

Proposed next steps: Irene will upload the raw artifacts to a shared Drive folder and also attach a CSV inventory. If you prefer we can also deliver an encrypted ZIP over the portal. Can you confirm whether redaction of user_id (UUID) is acceptable, or do you need the raw IDs?

Irene/Laura — target to upload by EOD tomorrow (2026-03-02).

Markus / Irene —

Redaction of UUIDs is acceptable provided there is a reversible mapping or an internal index so we can validate uniqueness/sequence. If you redact, please include a short note describing the redaction method and the key fields left intact (e.g., user.email, external_id_prefix).

For the role-owner CSV, our minimum required columns are: role_name, owner_email, owner_team (optional), effective_date. If you can include last_assignment_source (SCIM/manual) that helps triage anomalies.

Also, could you confirm your SCIM server's behavior on conflicting updates (last-write-wins versus versioned attributes)? That will guide how we interpret the deltas.

If uploading to Drive, please mark the folder "Medix SOC2 - Redwood - Evidence" and drop a README.txt with retention/collection notes.

Thanks — we'll hold on review until we receive the artifacts.

Sofia
